introduction: Delaware weatherization provides free energy-efficiency services for qualifying homes. The Energy Coordinating Agency handles statewide intake.
description: Delaware weatherization provides free energy-efficiency services for qualifying homes. The Energy Coordinating Agency handles statewide intake.

sections.who: Eligibility depends on household size and income. Homeowners and renters can apply; service priority and annual funding affect the waiting list.
sections.get: An energy audit selects conservation work such as insulation and air sealing. This is not a general home-repair program or a routine window replacement service.

sections.apply:
1. Arrange intake

    Call Energy Coordinating Agency at 302-504-6111 through the DNREC WAP page.

  2. Confirm the document list

    Bring the requested records and discuss the home’s heating and safety concerns.

  3. Arrange audit and contractor access

    An approved home is assessed before recommended work and a final quality inspection.
sections.after: An adult must be available for contractor visits. DNREC says households not served within 12 months must reapply annually.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DNREC WAP eligibility and intake. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
